title: Cora demo series agenda
text: Welcome to the Cora acoustic and navigation demo series. This opening is an agenda for the clips that follow: beamformed forward sonar, O F D M and conventional modems, JANUS interoperability, a simulated navigation mission, the Vivado block design, and measured modem performance.
evidence: The overview visibly lists every completed demo topic and confirms the live service probe.

title: One Cora board, simultaneous services
text: This live check shows six board-hosted services responding together on the same Cora Z7-10: sonar, O F D M, conventional modulation, JANUS, and the two navigation views. The Vivado clip explains their common A X I stream hardware path. The later combined video will retain each chapter's evidence and context.
evidence: All six live service tiles showed UP during the recorded introduction.
